text:
incident-bot: PAGE: P0 - multiple containers restarting (GPU OOM) during prefill on us-west-2-prod cluster. Alert group: gpu-prefill. Pager sent to oncall. 
ryan_oncall: ACK - I'm on it, jumping into the affected node list. 
ana_eng: Seeing a spike in long-context requests hitting /v1/generate with seq len ~120k tokens, increased prefix cache thrash. 
kirill_runtime: Logs show repeated container exits with `OOM killed` and CUDA driver resets. tagging eng-runtime. 
sophie_sre: Noted node flaps on gce-gpu-ops-3 around the same time, kernel messages below. 
sophie_sre: ```
Feb 14 03:22:11 gce-gpu-ops-3 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 3245 (infer-server) score 158 or sacrifice child
Feb 14 03:22:11 gce-gpu-ops-3 kernel: Killed process 3245 (infer-server) total-vm:12345678kB, anon-rss:9876540kB
Feb 14 03:22:12 gce-gpu-ops-3 nvidia: UVM: PID 3245: UVM fault on 0x7f9b... code 0x4
Feb 14 03:22:12 gce-gpu-ops-3 nvidia: GPU reset detected
``` 
ryan_oncall: kubectl logs show repeated prefill threads allocating large KV caches then crash. snippet: 
```
[2026-02-14T03:21:59Z] prefill: allocating kv cache 9.8GB for request id req-abc123
[2026-02-14T03:22:10Z] prefill: cache growth exceeded limit, triggering eviction policy
[2026-02-14T03:22:11Z] ERROR: failed allocation: cannot allocate memory
[2026-02-14T03:22:11Z] FATAL: Received SIGKILL, shutting down
``` 
kirill_runtime: Looks like long prompt + unbounded KV cache growth when many concurrent prefill threads hit high seq lengths. Our memory accounting underestimated worst-case when prefix isn't reused. 
ana_eng: Quick mitigation: enable `prefill_max_seq=32k` on the route and turn on `kv_eviction_mode=strict`. Can we patch the config in prod? 
ryan_oncall: Rolling patch to route config (canary to 10% first) now. `kubectl apply -f prefillsafe-config.yaml` -> rolling update. deploy-bot: started rollout to 10% 
deploy-bot: rollout status: 4/4 pods updated in canary pool. 
liz_cs: Any customer impact? I see spikes in 5xxs for a set of customers. Which tenants are failing? 
ryan_oncall: Initial telemetry: 74k requests failed in last 30m, ~3% of global traffic. Top affected tenants: retail-ml (3 customers), callgen-beta (internal), and two smaller customers on dedicated pools. 
liz_cs: I'll prepare a short status note for customer-facing channels: summary + ETA for mitigation. 
kirill_runtime: Additional live mitigation: cordon and drain the flapping node `gce-gpu-ops-3`, redistribute pods, and enable `fallback_to_cpu=true` on the oldest model variant to soak requests without GPU while we stabilize. Doing that now. 
sophie_sre: Cordon/drain in progress, ETA ~2m for pods to reschedule. Node shows GPU resets; I recommend we mark node for maintenance after stabilization. 
ana_eng: Also enabling `batch_size_limit=1` for affected model route to reduce transient memory pressure for now. 
ana_eng: Patch applied to canary, pushing to 100% now. deploy-bot: rolling update to 100% started. 
ryan_oncall: Observability: error rate dropping from 3% -> 0.6% over 8 minutes after config rollouts and node drain. Latency increased ~120ms due to CPU fallback for some requests. 
kirill_runtime: Found one container crash that shows CUDA driver complaining before OOM: ```
E GPU0 nvidia  : GPUAssert: out of memory at /workspace/runtime/alloc.c:452
E GPU0 nvidia  : Traceback (most recent call last):
E GPU0 nvidia  :   Allocation failed for KV cache of 10.2GB
``` 
ryan_oncall: Confirming no more spontaneous container restarts in the last 6 minutes on the cluster. Monitoring for 30m. 
liz_cs: Customer note drafted: short explanation, impacted customers, mitigation steps taken (rate-limited canary, kv eviction, CPU fallback), and we'll follow up with post-incident writeup. Sharing in #customer-updates in 10. 
sophie_sre: Opening a follow-up incident ticket for node maintenance and kernel + nvidia driver upgrade candidate. tagging @infra-team. 
nana_eng: Next steps for runtime team: add defensive upper bound on KV cache per-request, add accounting for worst-case long-seq prefill, and add metric to alert when kv cache > 70% of GPU mem. 
kirill_runtime: Agreed. Also we'll add safe-fallback policy to move extremely long-prefill requests to a limited-capacity CPU spill path instead of letting GPU allocation grow unbounded. 
ryan_oncall: Thanks everyone. I'll hand off to kirill for postmortem and follow-ups. Marking pager RESOLVED for oncall rotation. :thumbsup: 
kirill_runtime: Taking handoff. I'll coordinate the postmortem and schedule the driver/kernel upgrade plan. Posting action items in a separate thread. 
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Pager resolved at 03:37 UTC. Total affected requests: 74,312. Escalated to eng-runtime for follow-up.
